notablePrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Priest of Gix with haste.
The Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki
